description.narrative: The project aims to improve water supply services in Grand Moroni by focusing on access to and maintenance for basic water supply systems, supporting water service provider performance improvements and improving the resilience of water supply systems to shocks. The project will also support rehabilitation of production, storage and water supply connections. Institutional support, for both water supply and sanitation, will also be provided at the national level to ensure sustainability of service provision and to prepare future sector investments.
